serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Will the show be alright? I didn’t want to put additional stress on Annalie, but her friends don’t seem to be reliable people. There's only a few days left until the show!
Bot: According to my estimate the chances that they will come are 50/50.
You: We can’t decide for Annalie. All we can do is trust her judgment. 
You: Things are a little different this time. Someone got sick. Let’s not judge them too early, ok? 
Bot: Sure…
Bot: Sometimes I forget how fragile the human body is. With so much danger all around outside and inside… I don’t think I would be able to live like that…
